snapshot.summary:
- Main purpose: a demo e-commerce site for browsing products, viewing details, adding items to a shopping cart and exercising auth/navigation/API-related features for testing.
- Core user flows: browse categories (WOMEN/MEN/KIDS), view product details, Add to cart → View Cart, Signup / Login, top navigation (Home, Products, Test Cases, API Testing, Contact us), and access to API list / Video Tutorials.
- Secondary flows: brand/category filtering, product listing pagination, View Product modal/page, and using Test Cases/API Testing links.
- Key UI actions to validate: menu navigation, product selection, add-to-cart behavior, cart view/update, auth (signup/login) and session handling.
- Data/state edge cases: cart persistence across sessions/logouts, multiple tabs altering cart, adding same item repeatedly, large quantity values, and empty-cart states.
- Content/consistency edge cases: mismatched product counts (category badges), missing images/descriptions, incorrect price/total calculations, stale stock info.
- Robustness/perf edge cases: slow/failed network, broken links, API responses errors, and long lists/pagination performance.
- Input/validation edge cases: invalid signup/login inputs, special characters in fields, client-side vs server-side validation differences.

snapshot.summary:
- Main purpose: display the full product catalog so users can browse items, filter by category/brand, open product details, and add products to the shopping cart.
- Primary user flows: navigate site (Home, Products, Contact, Test Cases, API Testing, Video Tutorials), select a category/brand filter (WOMEN/MEN/KIDS, brands with counts), open a product (View Product) and Add to cart, then View Cart; login/signup flow available (Signup / Login).
- Secondary flows: site-wide navigation (cart icon, View Cart), page utility (#scrollUp) and top menu links.
- Important functional checks: Add to cart updates cart contents/count and persists across pages and after sign-in/sign-out; View Product loads correct product details (image, price, description).
- Filtering/counts edge cases: brand counts match visible products after filters; selecting multiple filters or empty-result states handled gracefully (no broken layout).
- Concurrency/quantity edge cases: adding same product repeatedly updates quantity correctly; rapid repeated clicks don’t create duplicate inconsistent state.
- Authorization/cart edge cases: adding to cart while not logged in should behave consistently (guest cart persisted or merged on login) and appropriate redirects occur after login.
- Data/UI integrity edge cases: missing images/prices, malformed product links, incorrect URL paths, or broken View Product/View Cart links; price formatting and totals correctness.
- Usability/responsiveness/accessibility: navbar/menu collapse on small screens, scrollUp visibility, keyboard/ARIA operability, and correct focus/scroll behavior after actions (add/view).

snapshot.summary:
- Main purpose: allow users to register or log in and access e-commerce sections (Home, Products, Cart) and site resources (Test Cases, API Testing, Video Tutorials, Contact us).
- Main user flows: user signup (registration form), user login (credentials input + Login button), newsletter subscribe (#susbscribe_email + Subscribe button), top navigation to Home/Products/Cart/other pages, page scroll (#scrollUp).
- Inputs present: multiple form fields for signup/login and a dedicated subscribe email input.
- Important edge cases — input validation: empty fields, invalid email formats, very long input, leading/trailing whitespace.
- Authentication edge cases: wrong credentials, locked/disabled accounts, SQL injection/XSS attempts in username/password fields.
- Signup edge cases: duplicate email registrations, weak password acceptance, missing required fields, client vs server validation mismatch.
- UI/flow edge cases: broken navigation links, missing/incorrect element IDs (note #susbscribe_email typo), Subscribe/Login/Signup buttons disabled or unresponsive, session/cookie persistence after login/logout.
